evidence.sourceQuote: Water evaporates when heated. Water vapor condenses when cooled. Precipitation returns water to the ground. Water collects in rivers and lakes.
evidence.explanation: Heating produces water vapor through evaporation; cooling vapor produces droplets through condensation.
